cause: A synchronous watcher issues an intermediate (new account, old recording) request when Vue updates both props; it consumes the intended final response and fails closed on identity mismatch.
correction: Batch the watcher before the next render; clear prior rows and advance the generation in that pre-render callback. Retain all response identity checks and late-response rejection.
test_case_preserved_and_strengthened: Same failing rapid-switch scenario now also requires exactly two total API requests.
